New: five vintage map styles 🗺️ Swipe through 👉

1. Antique: hand-coloured borders, sea monsters and a scroll title, like the maps of the 1700s
2. Heritage: a Victorian town plan, every street and building engraved
3. Touring: a 1920s road map, with red roads, green woods and brown hills
4. Railway poster: bold, flat 1930s travel-poster colours
5. Watercolour: soft painted washes and handwritten names

Which would you hang? 👇
